name: At Your Royal Command
source:
A botched robbery lands you in the royal dungeon of Sybarith. The brooding heir offers a deadly deal: the executioner’s blade or total submission as their personal attendant. 

In a court fueled by debauchery, your defiance only sharpens the heir’s desire, turning a struggle for survival into a dangerous, soul-binding intimacy.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/At_Your_Royal_Command]Choices Wikia[/url]]
